I added some code to try to gather a pair of the offending stacktraces, but this may be a bit of a Heisenbug: the issue has not happened after I added the instrumentation! This isn't terribly surprising as grabbing a stack trace requires a jvm safepoint. I'll try a different approach where I only grab the second stack trace...

No dice with the alternate approach, but I did still observe the strange mismatch. New theory is that we're potentially getting `inactive` events without a prior corresponding `active` event. I'm adding instrumentation to capture stack traces for any such events now.
@cconroy stay tuned I may have an idea what the problem is.

My latest instrumentation captured the offending stacktrace:


I added some code to track firing of active/inactive events in my metrics handler

```
    if (activeFired == 1 && inactiveFired == 0) {
      currentConnections.dec();
    } else {
      logger.warn("Out of order inactive fired activeFired=%d, inactiveFired=%d, channel=%s",
          new Throwable(), activeFired, inactiveFired, ctx.channel());
    }
    inactiveFired++;
    super.channelInactive(ctx);
```

We are getting inactive events before any active events via the IdleStateHandler:

`Out of order inactive fired activeFired=0, inactiveFired=0`

rename.to: channelInactive events with no previous channelActive

body: I've updated the title of the issue to reflect these new findings.
